Following the surgery my toe became very very painful and my peripheral neuropathy pain also worsened.
I went back to see him and asked if he could refer me somewhere. He was honestly not intetested & did not take it seriously.
I later made a point of insisting that someone do something, & was referred to MSK, but after waiting to see them, I was told that they couldn't see me & that I'd been sent to the wrong place.
I made another appointment at Bacon Lane, & saw someone else but again was told nothing could be done. My toe was in excruciating pain so I felt I had to go private even thought I couldn't really afford it. Going to Harley Street was an eye opener. I discovered that the acid used in the operation (Phenol) had caused nerve damage in my toe causing intense pain, & is also effecting my whole body which is likely to be permanent.
Dr Hasham knew that I had peripheral neuropathy, it's in my records, and I mentioned it on the day of the surgery. He should honestly have known that Phenol should not be used on someone with peripheral neuropathy , but instead a different acid should have been used.
I'm still under private treatment, but laser treatment has not helped so far, there are few options. I'm now likely to be in a lot of pain 24/7 forever because if this oversight.
Naturally I'm not very happy at all.",null,[0,194]]]],[null,1773151904000000,1773151904000000,"a week ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/9297046194900226576/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnc1V1ZwcVdrbGtWbWQ1VDFaS1RWWXhSa3BrUlVadlVWaEpkR0V3UlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/9297046194900226576/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnc1V1ZwcVdrbGtWbWQ1VDFaS1RWWXhSa3BrUlVadlVWaEpkR0V3UlJBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/9297046194900226576/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnc1V1ZwcVdrbGtWbWQ1VDFaS1RWWXhSa3BrUlVadlVWaEpkR0V3UlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/9297046194900226576/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnc1V1ZwcVdrbGtWbWQ1VDFaS1RWWXhSa3BrUlVadlVWaEpkR0V3UlJBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/9297046194900226576/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnc1V1ZwcVdrbGtWbWQ1VDFaS1RWWXhSa3BrUlVadlVWaEpkR0V3UlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/9297046194900226576/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnc1V1ZwcVdrbGtWbWQ1VDFaS1RWWXhSa3BrUlVadlVWaEpkR0V3UlJBQhAA"],null,["en"],[["Thank you for taking the time to share your experience, and we are truly sorry to hear about the ongoing pain and difficulties you have been facing since your toenail procedure. We are especially sorry that you felt your concerns were not taken seriously and that the referral pathway did not work as it should have. Your feedback highlights areas where we must do better.

We would very much like the opportunity to review this in detail, including the clinical aspects of your care, the referrals made, and any communication issues that may have occurred. As we cannot discuss personal medical matters publicly, we kindly ask that you contact the surgery so we can arrange a full review and ensure your concerns are properly addressed.
Please feel free to email us at baconlane.surgery@nhs.net or contact reception Team about this. We are committed to supporting you and to learning from your experience.

Thank you again for raising this with us.
Bacon Lane Surgery Management
